# Large anchor target fixture

Exactly one thing that must NOT be flagged: this anchor is genuinely valid. `target.md`
is generated by the test (see `build_large_anchor_target`) with enough headings to make
a `heading_slugs | grep -q` pipeline short-circuit, SIGPIPE the producer, and — under
`set -o pipefail` — report this valid anchor as broken.

See [first](target.md#first-heading) for details.
